sections.title: Page 7
sections.extract: Background There were an estimated 10.6 million people who newly developed tuberculosis (TB) in 2022 and of the 7.5 million reported cases, 83% involved the lungs (WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2023). In 2022, there were about 410,000 new cases of rifampicin-resistant or multidrug resistant TB. Several rapid molecular tests are recommended by the WHO as the initial diagnostic test for TB, some of which can detect

sections.extract: Culture (microbiological reference standard) Culture is considered the best reference standard for TB using either automated liquid culture or solid culture methods. Since both culture methods are used interchangeably in clinical practice (Moreira 2015), a positive result either alone or in combination was accepted as a diagnosis of TB while all negative cultures indicated no TB. sections.extract: Background: Tuberculosis (TB) remains one of the leading causes of morbidity and mortality globally.
